'''Benthar's Boys''' were a youth gang that operated in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Starpoint (city)|Starpoint]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were led by [[Benthar]], and included gang members [[Droxie]] and [[Krystick Moonskimmer]]. They were involved in a turf war with the [[Vibroblade gang]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents on Draenell's Point convinced Benthar's Boys and the Vibroblades to unite and form a Rebel cell on the planet.<ref name="BB" />
